run_inference_main: run LCLM inference on LOFT with a specified prompt, model, and data split
run_inference_get_num_tokens: run inference and estimate the number of tokens in a text input string
run_inference_run_one_example: run inference on a single example using a model and return the output dict
run_inference_cache_first_input: run inference with prefix caching enabled on the first input example
run_inference_parallel_workers: run inference across multiple examples using a thread pool with configurable workers
